problem: It says the soft-margin dual introduces one multiplier α_i ≥ 0 per training point. With slack, the multipliers are also capped: 0 ≤ α_i ≤ C. Stating only α_i ≥ 0 is the hard-margin condition and can make a student think C does not bound the multipliers at all.
fix: The dual form introduces one multiplier α_i per point, with 0 ≤ α_i ≤ C in the soft-margin case (α_i ≥ 0 only in the hard-margin case). Points with α_i = 0 do not affect the boundary; points with α_i > 0 are the support vectors.
